snippet.title: World Soccer Champs trailer
snippet.description:
Download today and play for FREE! 
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.monkeyibrow.worldsoccerchamps

Manage your team and try to lead them to sweet success on this fun and thrilling soccer game. Includes real football leagues from around the world, as well as loads of local clubs.  

The sleek interface will completely immerse you in the electrifying drama of every match. Impress the fans and pass, dribble and shoot your way to victory using intuitive swipe-controls.
Manage your team, score goals, win trophies, change clubs and reach victory! 
 
by Monkey I-Brow Studios (www.monkeyibrowstudios.com)
